verdict.rationale: Bento has a built-in AI builder, so letting users plug MCP servers into it is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence shows only that Bento hosts its own MCP server for external AI assistants (the server role). Nothing shows Bento acting as an MCP client that can connect to third-party MCP servers and use their tools, so the server evidence earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
